title: Master of Dragons + Dynamic Dragon Scales
problem: Repeat tests the caster's side, but the Scales holder is on the other side: a player Dragon party never gets it. Community: Master of Dragons doesn't work with Dynamic Dragon Scales.
notes: In-game test: Master of Dragons: give one of your creatures Dynamic Dragon Scales and attack it with an enemy Dragon, then put Scales on an enemy and attack it with your Dragon; the extra activation happens only in the second case (your Dragons). Fix: H

release_notes.effect: Master of Dragons with Dynamic Dragon Scales (trait)
release_notes.intended: Your Dragons' innate traits activate 1 additional time.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, the repeat checked the enemy caster instead of your Dragon, so your Dragons never got it.
release_notes.fix: Now the extra activation applies to your Dragons.
